item.title: Tom Homan Spars With CBS Host Over ‘Unreasonable’ Demands To Unmask Federal Law Enforcement
item.description: Border czar Tom Homan sparred Sunday with a CBS News host who pressed him about demands from Democrats to prohibit federal immigration enforcement officers from wearing masks when on duty.

item.title: LYNN WESTMORELAND: How Foreign Investors Profit From US Lawsuits And Drive Up Consumer Prices
item.description: Americans are desperate for relief from rising prices. The November 2025 elections made that clear, as “affordability” dominated every focus group, every poll, and every concession speech. If Republicans plan to regain voter trust, they need to address one of the most under-recognized drivers of higher costs: the exploding litigation finance industry.

item.title: Liberal Podcaster Brian Tyler Cohen Ripped Over Reaction To Obama’s Unprecedented Answer To Existential Question
item.description: Observers blasted left-wing podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen after former President Barack Obama expressed during an interview his belief that aliens are real — only to fail to ask him a follow-up question to expand on the existential admission.

item.title: Rep Anna Paulina Luna Reveals How Election Bill Democrats Hate Might Have Fighting Chance Of Passage
item.description: Republican Florida Rep. Anna Paulina Luna said during a Sunday appearance on Fox News she thinks there is chance the Senate can pass the SAVE America Act — despite fierce Democratic opposition — if the GOP is willing to use a little-known tactic.

item.title: WILL THIBEAU: Hegseth Pentagon Finally Asks Hard Questions About Women In Combat
item.description: Secretary of War Pete Hegseth is willing to do what it takes to reform the Pentagon into an organization capable of waging the campaigns necessary to defend America and protect her interests. This willingness even extends to questioning maxims of the establishment agenda like the false notion that all military units should be bastions of equal opportunity for men and women.

item.title: Tearful Plea: Savannah Guthrie Begs For Mom’s Safe Return
item.description: Her message was aimed squarely at the person she believes is holding her 84-year-old mother, Nancy Guthrie.

item.title: Forensic Team Demands Kurt Cobain Case Reopened With Homicide Claim
item.description: Their claims revisit long-debated theories that have circulated among fans for years, including allegations that Cobain was forced to take a massive dose of heroin before he was shot.

item.title: LEIF LARSON: Your Local ‘Non-Profit’ Hospital May Be Gaming The Tax System—And You’re Paying For It
item.description: When you receive care at a non-profit hospital, you might assume that institution operates as a true charity—foregoing taxes in exchange for serving the community. You would be wrong.

item.title: Father Accused of Stabbing Infant in Alleged ‘Sacrifice’ Attack
item.description: Authorities said the mother “used her body to shield her child from further harm” until first responders arrived.

item.title: ‘Silence of the Lambs’ Star Concedes Buffalo Bill Portrayal Was ‘Unfortunate’
item.description: “There are certain aspects of the movie that don’t hold up too well."
